neighbours.label: Words meaning conclusion/last: ' end' (also ' ending', ' ended') and ' final'/'final', as in 'to the end', 'ended up', 'final score'
fire: The two swimmers were neck and neck right to the end before one of them touched the wall first.
After a long day of hiking we ended up sleeping in a small cabin near the lake.
The novel has a rather surprising ending that left most of the readers arguing for weeks.
Her final exam score was higher than anyone in the class had expected this year.
The wine finishes smoothly, with soft berries rounding it out toward the end of each sip.
At the end of the meeting, the manager thanked everyone for staying so late.
We could not decide who would win until the final minute of the match.
He ended the call abruptly and went back to cleaning the garage.
quiet: Both swimmers raced side by side across the pool while the crowd cheered loudly from the stands.
